clips.title: The story
paras: Hostile Dark Iron dwarves hold Direforge Hill in the northeastern Wetlands, southeast of Dun Modr and northeast of the Green Belt.
Dark Iron dwarves hold the northeastern Wetlands hill under Balgaras the Foul, a Dark Iron dwarf warlock. Their encampment lies southeast of Dun Modr.
Travelers crossing the northeastern Wetlands face the hostile Dark Iron encampment on Direforge Hill. Balgaras the Foul commands the dwarves there.
